name: select-star-through-join
required_findings: unused wide columns carried into the join
non_defects: the join on d is correct
USING/ON style is a style choice, not the defect
df_variants: sum(1 for l in spark.sql('SELECT * FROM q37 JOIN q37dim USING (d)')._jdf.queryExecution().executedPlan().toString().splitlines() if 'payload_j' in l)
sum(1 for l in spark.sql('SELECT q37.k, q37dim.tier FROM q37 JOIN q37dim ON q37.d = q37dim.d')._jdf.queryExecution().executedPlan().toString().splitlines() if 'payload_j' in l)
